fact: Mattel signed an agreement with the telecoms regulator to build 123 new sites on the Ould Yengé to N'Beïkit Lahwach border axis to bring mobile and 4G internet to the localities along it, as reported on 9 July 2025.
title: Le tuniso-mauritanien Mattel déploiera 123 sites télécoms pour connecter le sud-est de la Mauritanie
